data.text:
APPROVED: All acceptance criteria validated against commit 20521f999 in worktree .worktrees/tk-ljk.

Criterion -> evidence:
1. Project name suffix per worktree (dir-derived default): dockerCompose() rewrites project.Name to '<authored>-wt-<worktree>' via wtComposeProjectName when the thread carries a worktree context (starkit.WorktreeContextOf, stamped by worktree.Plugin.OnStart from the tilt.dev/worktree label). Evidence: TestDockerComposeProjectName_WorktreeRun/dir-derived_default PASS (feat-auth-wt-feat-auth) — .agents/match/validations/tk-ljk-tests.txt.
2. Explicit DockerComposeProject.Name override: same gate covers explicit project_name=; TestDockerComposeProjectName_WorktreeRun/explicit_project_name PASS (hello-wt-feat-auth). Main runs keep authored names: TestDockerComposeProjectName_MainRunUnchanged PASS (hello, no suffix).
3. dc_resource(project_name=) authored->engine translation: authoredDCProjectName re-applies the suffix before getDCService lookup; TestDockerComposeDCResourceAuthoredProjectName_WorktreeRun PASS.
4. Published ports deconflicted via port registry (phase 3): deconflictDCPorts gated to worktree runs; rebinds fixed numeric host bindings via portregistry.Allocate keyed wtPortOwner(dc:<engine-project>/<svc>:<target>/<proto>) (reload-stable, per-worktree distinct); rewritten config materialized as single temp YAML repointing ConfigPaths (runtime + reload diff); parsed services re-mutated so PublishedPorts/UI links match. compose-go appends ports across -f files (no override rule), so the tempfile rewrite (not an -f override) is the correct mechanism. Evidence: TestDockerComposeWorktreePortDeconflict (main keeps 12312; feat-auth and fix-bug rebind to range, runtime YAML carries rebinding and drops 12312) and TestDockerComposeTwoWorktreesNoPortClash PASS (distinct projects feat-auth-wt-feat-auth vs fix-bug-wt-fix-bug, distinct allocated ports, neither holds authored 12312).
5. Reload stability: TestDockerComposeWorktreePortStableAcrossReloads PASS (same allocation across two Loads).
6. port_range feed: tiltfileLoader.Load calls portregistry.SetPortRange(wtState.PortMin, wtState.PortMax); consumer parity with tk-zfi portforward wiring confirmed on master.

Test runs (in worktree): worker's exact acceptance command green (7 tests incl. subtests); full ./internal/tiltfile/ + ./internal/tiltfile/starkit/ green except known-baseline TestKustomizeFlags/TestKustomizeBin (no kustomize binary on PATH — confirmed  empty; pre-declared ignore). go vet + gofmt clean on changed files. Evidence: .agents/match/validations/tk-ljk-tests.txt, .agents/match/validations/tk-ljk-diff-review.txt (committed 2bd4d478b).
